jhj 混元视频工作流程

目前只有 txt2vid 工作流程。

它从以下位置加载 GGUF：

https://huggingface.co/city96/HunyuanVideo-gguf/tree/main

它首先生成分辨率较小的视频 -> 然后根据 VRAM 的限制进行升级。

也许您最好为自己的目的找到一个更好的升级模型。

版本控制在：
https://github.com/jhj0517/ComfyUI-workflows

o.en:
jhj Hunyuan Video workflows

Only txt2vid workflow for now.

It loads GGUF from:

https://huggingface.co/city96/HunyuanVideo-gguf/tree/main

It first generates video with smaller resolution -> then upscales for the limits of VRAM.

Probably you better find a better upscaling model for your own purpose.

The version is controlled in :
https://github.com/jhj0517/ComfyUI-workflows
